description: Create a project and/or folder in BrowserStack Test Management. Creating a project needs no identifier. Creating a folder inside an EXISTING project needs that project's identifier (PR-*); no tool here lists projects, so ask askBrowserStackAI with product "tm" for it.

folder_name.description: Name of the folder to create.

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID; if omitted, folder is created at root.

project_identifier.description: Existing project identifier to use for folder creation.

project_name.description: Name of the project to create.

name: createProjectOrFolder
